meta.name: analytical-method-validation
meta.description: Plan, execute, and document validation, verification, and transfer of analytical procedures under the governing framework - ICH Q2(R2) and Q14, USP <1220>/<1225>/<1226>, ICH M10 bioanalytical, CLSI EP, or ISO/IEC 17025. Use for HPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC, CE, ICP-MS, dissolution, qNMR, qPCR, NIR, and ligand binding or cell-based assays whenever the question is whether a procedure is fit for its intended purpose. Triggers include "method validation", "analytical method validation", "AMV", "validation protocol", "acceptance criteria", "linearity", "reportable range", "accuracy and precision", "repeatability", "intermediate precision", "recovery", "LOD", "LOQ", "detection limit", "quantitation limit", "specificity", "robustness", "method transfer", "method comparison", "Deming", "Passing-Bablok", "Bland-Altman", "equivalence testing", "OOS investigation", "ICH Q2", "Q2(R2)", "Q14", "USP 1225", "ICH M10", "incurred sample reanalysis", "ISR", "CLSI EP", and any request to show that an assay works.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把关分析检测方法是否经得起验证审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要给实验室检测方法准备验证和证明材料。
copy.tagline_en: Prove your lab method is reliable for its intended use before release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must show an analytical method is fit for its intended purpose under regulations.

howto.what: 它帮你规划并核算分析方法验证:先定适用框架(如 ICH Q2(R2)、USP、ICH M10),再列出必做指标、生成方案骨架,并算出线性、准确度精密度、检出限、方法比对等统计量。只报告,不下结论。
howto.when: 当你提到“方法验证”“验收标准”“方法转移”等关键词,或要设计验证方案、核查验证数据、判断某方法是否适合其用途时触发。

say.text: 用 ICH Q2(R2) 给 HPLC 含量测定生成验证方案骨架
检查这份校准数据在 80–120% 范围内的线性
say.note: 会算失拟检验与回算误差,不只看 r²

say.text: 按 ICH M10 核查这份配体结合实验的批运行
say.note: 按模态判定各浓度 QC 是否达标

howto.what_en: It plans and computes method validation: picks the framework (ICH Q2(R2), USP, ICH M10), lists characteristics, drafts the protocol, and computes linearity, accuracy/precision, detection limits and method comparison. Reports only.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "method validation", "acceptance criteria", "method transfer" etc., or ask to design a validation study, review data, or judge whether a procedure is fit for its purpose.

say_en.text: Use ICH Q2(R2) to draft a validation protocol skeleton for an HPLC assay
say_en.note: Acceptance criteria are left blank for you to set

say_en.text: Check whether this calibration is linear across 80-120%
say_en.note: Reports lack-of-fit and back-calculated error, not just r2

say_en.text: Check this ligand binding run against ICH M10
say_en.note: Enforces per-level QC rules for the chosen modality
